description: This file defines a custom attribute class in C# used within the Orleans framework for silo placement filtering based on metadata preferences. The class specifies an attribute to prioritize silos that match certain metadata keys, with configurable parameters for matching depth and candidate count.

classes.name: PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute
classes.description: An attribute class used to specify preferred silo placement filters based on metadata matching within the Orleans framework.
